name: media-motion

motion.notes: 3 thin white arcs travel away from the Discord mark, 2.8 s per wave, radius 30 to 60 pt, from -20 to +54 degrees (to the right and slightly down), opacity sin(pi*phase)^1.3 * 0.55 * 0.5, line width (1.5 - 0.8 phase) * 0.85. Screen blend.

every 5.2 s a soft band 32 pt wide (opacity 0.11 in the middle), tilted 0.45 rad, crosses the glass of the screen in 1.8 s (eased), clipped to the rounded rectangle of the display; the play button flares (radial glow, radius 26 pt, up to 0.19) as the band passes. Screen blend.
every 3.9 s the eyes of the mark close for 0.2 s: a pearl ellipse (grey 212 * (0.30 + 0.70 lit)) grows over each eye from its middle and opens again.

strength.notes: The first version had both at 1.0; the user asked for quieter sound and a softer glint, so the delivered default is 0.5 and 0.55.

on.notes: the motion fades in over 1.5 s, starting 0.5 s after the switch is turned on (after the figure lights up)

busy.notes: run the motion clock 1.6 times faster and pulse the halo as on the other pages

draw_order: After the scene picture, before the front half of the halo.
notes: Nothing is pre-rendered: the motion is a few strokes and gradients, so it costs no memory and no files, only drawing. media-motion.js is the reference (canvas 2D): port it as it is. Reduce Motion: draw no motion, only the picture. There is no status light on this page (it was tried and dropped as out of character).
